summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The SMART Mid Cap ETF (SMCP) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in mid cap equity. The fund provides exposure to mid-cap US companies. The actively managed fund uses a multi-step process that identifies securities exhibiting strong momentum and revenue growth. SMCP was launched on May 12, 2026 and is issued by Smart.

holdings.infoBox: SMCP is an equity ETF with a total of 33 individual holdings. The top holdings are Kiniksa Pharmaceuticals International, stock at 8.45%, Warrior Met Coal at 6.84%, Compañía de Minas Buenaventura at 6.77%, Aya Gold & Silver at 6.49%, and Silicon Motion Technology at 5.76%.
